title: Outlet Adapter and Hose Parts for Returned PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Outlet Adapter and Hose Parts for Returned PAP Therapy Equipment

**Catalogue note.** The outlet part a returned self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit takes in reconditioning follows the tubing the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment records, and is added to the unit's reconditioning parts list at Summit Ridge list price:

- a patient whose active enrollment records **heated tubing** has the heated-tubing outlet adapter replaced at **12.00 USD**;
- a patient on **standard tubing with the humidifier in use** has the standard outlet hose replaced at **6.00 USD**;
- any other patient takes no outlet part.

**Where the facts are read.** Both the tubing and the humidifier use are read from the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment in status active: its heated-tubing indicator (heated tubing rather than standard tubing) and its humidifier-in-use indicator.

| Active enrollment: heated tubing | Active enrollment: humidifier in use | Outlet part | List price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | heated-tubing outlet adapter | 12.00 |
| yes | no | heated-tubing outlet adapter | 12.00 |
| no (standard tubing) | yes | standard outlet hose | 6.00 |
| no (standard tubing) | no | none | 0.00 |
| no active enrollment | — | none | 0.00 |

**Case (hypothetical).** A patient returns an Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601); the patient's active supply enrollment records standard tubing and the humidifier in use. The standard outlet hose is replaced at 6.00.
